entries.en:
You approach the House Manderville artisan with a request to forge a new Manderville weapon. The accommodating craftsman asks only that you supply him with the necessary chunks of manderium meteorite─an exhausting and expensive process with which you are already intimately familiar.

※You may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

entries.en: No sooner have you delivered the meteorite chunks into the artisan's hands than he and Gerolt collaborate in the creation of another masterful Manderville armament. Should you wish to expand your armory of Manderville weaponry, it seems you have only to ask...assuming you've brought a sufficient number of exorbitantly priced sky rocks, of course.
entries.fr: Gerolt n'attendait plus que vos morceaux de météorite pour relancer sa forge et créer une nouvelle arme légendaire des Manderville. Parlez à nouveau à l'artisan si vous souhaitez en fabriquer encore une autre.

entries.en: Ah, yes, the meteorite chunks! I certainly wasn't expecting a Hannish curry and a bottle of chilled lassi, no indeed... Ahem, the extraction process should take but a moment, so I shall call upon Master Gerolt to have his anvil ready.
